# Wed Sept 9 - Introduction

## Syllabus
We will discuss how your grade will be assessed, the material covered in the course, and the resources available to you.

## Use of AI in the course
Course policies on the use of generative artificial intelligence (genAI, for example Claude or ChatGPT) are informed by these readings:

- Bastani et al. 2025. [Generative AI without guardrails can harm learning](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2422633122). PNAS.
- Carlson lab blog. [The only reason you'll ever need not to write with AI](https://www.carlsonlab.bio/thoughts/the-only-reason-youll-ever-need-not-to-write-with-ai).
